title: Advice on Lasting Power of Attorney at Nursing Homes and Step-down Care Institutions
what_it_is: Advice on Lasting Power of Attorney at Nursing Homes and Step-down Care Institutions

sections.label: LPA awareness in nursing homes
sections.summary: Ministry and AIC have reached out to nursing home staff on Advance Care Planning and LPA, and AIC works with Pro Bono Services Office to offer legal clinics.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Health in respect of the elderly in nursing homes and step-down care institutions (a) whether the Ministry can consider providing awareness, education and counselling services on the need for a Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA) to them; and (b) whether the Ministry and the Agency for Integrated Care can work with the legal fraternity and assist to extend greater accessibility to pro bono legal services to those requiring LPAs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We have reached out to staff in close to three-quarters of all nursing homes on Advance Care Planning which can include the planning for an LPA so that care decisions can be in line with an individual's wishes in the event of mental incapacity.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: AIC conducts regular talks and case discussions with aged care providers to raise awareness on legal issues, such as LPA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, in October 2016, AIC partnered All Saints Home and the Pro Bono Services Office of the Law Society of Singapore to organise a seminar to provide nursing home staff a basic understanding of legal concepts, such as LPA, Mental Capacity Act and the Maintenance of Parents Act.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Close to 120 staff from more than half of local nursing home providers attended the event.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Separately, AIC is also working with the Pro Bono Services Office lawyers and aged care providers to offer legal clinics.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These legal clinics will provide pro bono services and consultation on legal issues, including LPA, for nursing home staff as well as residents and their family members.
